Connect demand, retained bytes, and concurrency with capacity evidence.
Adapt the design to failure and changed workload.

sections.title: Assessment session
sections.markdown: This catalog slot uses interview_002, a partial-design assessment. Start it in the Interview Center. The scheduled session is 60 minutes: 45 minutes of answering followed by 15 minutes of evidence-based feedback. The candidate brief is revealed when the attempt begins. Coaching mode permits requested hints; exam mode records hints and keeps the reference solution for the debrief. Do not use a normal lesson quiz as a substitute for this session.

exercise.prompt: Start the mapped interview, save your actual reasoning, then compare it with the rubric after submission.
rubric: Use the supplied interview rubric with evidence from the actual attempt.
exercise.solution: Reference reasoning belongs to the interview debrief and is withheld during the answering phase.
